name: fractal-flight
description: Dev-only tooling for Fractal Alps. The GAME has no dependencies and never will: test_build.js requires the shipped single-file artifact to fetch nothing, because it runs from a double-clicked file:// page. These are for the test suite alone -- nothing here is loaded by the browser, and `node test/run_tests.js` still works without them (the two suites that need them skip with a note).
